title: BAAI-Humanoid/MOSAIC
abstract:
MOSAIC: Bridging the Sim-to-Real Gap in Generalist Humanoid Motion Tracking and Teleoperation with Rapid Residual Adaptation

# MOSAIC Training Code [ ](https://docs.omniverse.nvidia.com/isaacsim/latest/overview.html) [ ](https://isaac-sim.github.io/IsaacLab) [ ](https://docs.python.org/3/whatsnew/3.10.html) [ ](https://releases.ubuntu.com/20.04/) [ ](https://pre-commit.com/) [ ](https://opensource.org/license/apache-2-0) [[Website]](https://baai-humanoid.github.io/MOSAIC/) [[Arxiv]](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2602.08594) [[Dataset]](https://huggingface.co/datasets/BAAI-Humanoid/MOSAIC_Dataset) [[Model]](https://huggingface.co/BAAI-Humanoid/MOSAIC_Model) ## Overview MOSAIC is an open-source system for generalist humanoid motion tracking and whole-body teleoperation across multiple interfaces. It trains a teleoperation-oriented tracker with rewards that emphasize global motion consistency for stable, long-horizon behaviors. To bridge sim-to-real interface gaps, it uses rapid residual adaptation to inject interface-specific corrections while preserving generality. This repo focuses on the teleoperation policy training; for sim-to-sim and sim-to-real deployment, see [RobotBridge](https://github.com/BAAI-Humanoid/RobotBridge). ## Installation - Install Isaac Lab v2.1.0 by following the [installation guide](https://isaac-sim.github.io/IsaacLab/main/source/setup/installation/index.html). We recommend using the conda installation as it simplifies calling Python scripts from the terminal. - Clone this repository separately from the Isaac Lab installation (i.e., outside the `IsaacLab` directory): - Using a Python interpreter that has Isaac Lab installed, install the library and install the algorithm library ## General Training Pipeline ### Motion Preprocessing We store all processed motions locally. abstract_zh: MOSAIC 是一个开源系统，用于跨多种界面的通用人形机器人运动跟踪和全身遥操作。它训练了一个面向遥操作的跟踪器，其奖励强调全局运动一致性，以实现稳定的长时程行为。为了弥合仿真到现实的界面差距，它采用快速残差适应来注入特定于界面的修正，同时保持通用性。本仓库专注于遥操作策略训练；对于仿真到仿真和仿真到现实的部署，请参见 RobotBridge。
tldr_zh: MOSAIC 通过快速残差适应弥合仿真到现实的差距，实现通用人形运动跟踪与遥操作。
cover_zh: 人形机器人遥操作总翻车？这个新框架用残差适应让仿真到现实无缝衔接！

judge.reason: 官方开源人形全身运动跟踪与遥操作训练系统，含数据集与模型，具科研价值。
